story.text: 오랜만에 평일 휴가를 맞춰, 대전 오월드로 향했습니다. 놀이공원 입구부터 신이 난 친구가 제 팔을 잡아끌었습니다.
story.reading: o-raen-man-e pyeong-il hyu-ga-reul mat-chwo, dae-jeon o-wol-deu-ro hyang-haess-seum-ni-da. nol-i-gong-won ib-gu-bu-teo sin-i nan chin-gu-ga je pal-eul jab-a-kkeul-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: For the first time in a while, we matched up a weekday off and headed to Daejeon O-World. Right from the entrance, my excited friend pulled me along by the arm.

story.text: "어떤 '놀이기구'부터 탈까?" 친구가 지도를 펼치며 눈을 반짝였습니다. 저는 팀장처럼 진지하게 동선을 검토했습니다.
story.reading: "eo-tteon 'nol-i-gi-gu'-bu-teo tal-kka?" chin-gu-ga ji-do-reul pyeol-chi-myeo nun-eul ban-jjag-yeot-seum-ni-da. jeo-neun tim-jang-cheo-reom jin-ji-ha-ge dong-seon-eul geom-to-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Which 'ride' should we go on first?" My friend spread out the map, eyes sparkling. I reviewed the route as seriously as a team leader.

story.text: 결국 첫 번째는 '롤러코스터'였습니다. 안전벨트를 채우는 손끝이 살짝 떨렸습니다.
story.reading: gyeol-guk cheot beon-jjae-neun 'rol-leo-ko-seu-teo'-yeot-seum-ni-da. an-jeon-bel-teu-reul chae-u-neun son-kkeut-i sal-jjak tteol-lyeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: In the end, the first one was the 'roller coaster.' My fingertips trembled slightly as I buckled the safety belt.

story.text: 출발 신호와 함께 레일이 요란하게 움직였습니다. 저도 모르게 비명이 터져 나왔습니다.
story.reading: chul-bal sin-ho-wa ham-kke re-il-i yo-ran-ha-ge um-jig-yeot-seum-ni-da. jeo-do mo-reu-ge bi-myeong-i teo-jyeo na-wat-seum-ni-da.
story.en: As soon as the departure signal sounded, the rail rattled to life. A scream burst out of me before I even realized it.

story.text: 숨을 고르고 나서 찾은 다음 코스는 '회전목마'였습니다. 친구는 이제야 좀 살겠다며 웃었습니다.
story.reading: sum-eul go-reu-go na-seo chaj-eun da-eum ko-seu-neun 'hoe-jeon-mok-ma'-yeot-seum-ni-da. chin-gu-neun i-je-ya jom sal-get-da-myeo us-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: After catching my breath, the next ride we found was the 'carousel.' My friend laughed, saying they could finally breathe again.

story.text: "오늘, 정말 '짜릿하다'." 흔들리는 목마 위에서 친구가 중얼거렸습니다. 저도 마음속 깊이 동의했습니다.
story.reading: "o-neul, jeong-mal 'jja-rit-ha-da'." heun-deul-li-neun mok-ma wi-e-seo chin-gu-ga jung-eol-geo-ryeot-seum-ni-da. jeo-do ma-eum-sok gip-i dong-ui-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Today is really 'thrilling'." My friend murmured, swaying on the wooden horse. I agreed deep in my heart too.

story.text: 해가 저물자 놀이공원 전체에 불이 켜졌습니다. 관람차 위에서 내려다본 '야경'은 숨이 멎을 만큼 아름다웠습니다.
story.reading: hae-ga jeo-mul-ja nol-i-gong-won jeon-che-e bul-i kyeo-jyeot-seum-ni-da. gwan-ram-cha wi-e-seo nae-ryeo-da-bon 'ya-gyeong'-eun sum-i myeoj-eul man-keum a-reum-da-wot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: As the sun set, lights came on across the whole amusement park. The 'night view' from the Ferris wheel was breathtakingly beautiful.

story.text: 관람차가 천천히 한 바퀴 도는 동안, 우리는 말없이 그 풍경을 눈에 담았습니다. 그날 나눈 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: gwan-ram-cha-ga cheon-cheon-hi han ba-kwi do-neun dong-an, u-ri-neun mal-eob-si geu pung-gyeong-eul nun-e dam-at-seum-ni-da. geu-nal na-nun dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: As the Ferris wheel slowly made its round, we silently took in the view. Let me share the conversation we had that day.

words.example_en: This park has really a lot of rides.
I rode the roller coaster and screamed.
The carousel is very popular with children.
The night view from the Ferris wheel was beautiful.

sentences.en: This park has really a lot of rides.
I rode the roller coaster and screamed.
The carousel is very popular with children.
The night view from the Ferris wheel was beautiful.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: What should we ride first? How about the roller coaster?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: Sounds good. Before we start, I'll check the safety belt first.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: So captain-like — doing a safety check even here.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: Occupational habit. But still... honestly, I'm a little nervous.

dialogues.question: 롤러코스터를 타기 전 상우가 가장 먼저 한 행동은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What was the first thing Sangwoo did before riding the roller coaster?
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 출발 전에 안전벨트부터 확인하겠다고 말하며 습관처럼 안전을 점검했습니다.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: The night view from the Ferris wheel is really special.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Right, today was really thrilling and fun.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: I laughed this freely for the first time in a while too.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Where should we go play next time?

dialogues.question: 관람차 위에서 상우는 어떤 감정을 느꼈나요?
dialogues.question_en: What emotion did Sangwoo feel on the Ferris wheel?
dialogues.correct_answer: 오랜만에 마음껏 웃을 만큼 즐거운 감정
options: 오랜만에 마음껏 웃을 만큼 즐거운 감정
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 오랜만에 이렇게 마음껏 웃었다고 말하며 즐거운 감정을 표현했습니다.
